manifest.name: compare_currencies_to_czk_cnb
manifest.description: Converts a list of foreign currencies to CZK using the CNB daily rate and ranks them by CZK value per unit, naming the strongest.
manifest.purpose: a bot that compares several foreign currencies against the Czech crown today and says which is strongest
manifest.headline: Against the Czech crown, {strongest} is the strongest at {ranking.0.czk_per_unit} CZK per unit and {weakest} is the weakest, based on the rate of {rate_date}.
examples: Which is stronger against the crown, dollar or euro?
Compare GBP, CHF and JPY to CZK today
Rank USD, EUR and PLN against the Czech koruna
manifest.manual_basis: Look up current CNB exchange rates for 5 currencies, convert 1 unit of each to CZK, rank by resulting values.
